# Temporal feedback extension: report (generated by `scripts/make_ext.py`; pre-registration and dated additions in `rule_extension.md`)

Logged stage-`temporal` compute: 18.71 A30-h. Everything here is exploratory unless marked confirmation.

## E1: feedback on the strong W4A4 baseline (PixArt-Σ, corrected H-SVDQuant r4, dynamic per-token A4; MJHQ `[:64]`, batch 1)

| arm | latent rel. MSE | vs its base [95% CI] | PSNR | ΔPSNR | LPIPS | ΔLPIPS | prediction C/I |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- | ---: |
| W4A4 base | 0.2174 | — | 17.17 | — | 0.455 | — | 0.0638 |
| W4A4 + uniform dither | 0.2458 | +13.1% [+5.3, +22.2] | 16.80 | -0.37 [-0.73, -0.02] | 0.511 | +0.057 [+0.049, +0.065] | 0.0568 |
| W4A4 + feedback | 0.2670 | +22.8% [+16.0, +31.1] | 16.21 | -0.96 [-1.29, -0.63] | 0.566 | +0.111 [+0.103, +0.120] | 0.0331 |
| W4A4 + feedback + unsigned-path guard (post hoc) | 0.2670 | +22.8% [+16.0, +31.1] | 16.22 | -0.95 [-1.29, -0.63] | 0.566 | +0.111 [+0.103, +0.120] | 0.0331 |
| W16A4 base (FP weights, no branch; diagnostic) | 0.2371 | — | 16.95 | — | 0.482 | — | 0.0587 |
| W16A4 + feedback (diagnostic) | 0.2887 | +21.8% [+12.9, +31.9] | 15.85 | -1.10 [-1.49, -0.71] | 0.604 | +0.122 [+0.115, +0.129] | 0.0355 |

- **Feedback fails on the dynamic-A4 bed.** It is worse than the base at W4A4. The guard (true clip rate 1.9% → 0.0001%) changes nothing, so clipping is not the cause. With FP weights (W16A4) feedback hurts by the same amount, so weight error is not hiding an activation gain. The stateless dither hurts too.
- **Interpretation (scope):** a dynamic per-token grid is recomputed from the current input every step, so its rounding error has little step-repeating component to cancel. Feedback and dither only add per-step error at a coarse 4-bit resolution. The method's domain is fixed-encoding static quantizers, where it works on both beds (stage 3).
- The E1 `clip_rate` of the first feedback run is a counter artifact (see rule_extension.md); later runs count true clips.

## E3: runtime with diagnostics disabled (DiT, batch 32 × 50 steps; warm-up + 5 synchronized repeats)

| none | 37.00 ± 0.00 s | 738.1 ms | 1.00× | 0 MiB | 4.31 GiB |
| unif | 37.02 ± 0.00 s | 738.6 ms | 1.00× | 0 MiB | 4.31 GiB |
| full | 73.64 ± 0.00 s | 1471.0 ms | 1.99× | 7056 MiB | 13.45 GiB |
| dct4 | 75.73 ± 0.00 s | 1512.7 ms | 2.05× | 110 MiB | 6.53 GiB |

- Eager PyTorch fake-quant: the baseline's 2.3× over FP is the simulation itself. Feedback's ≈ 2× over the baseline comes from its per-site elementwise chain, not from the state size. Compression (dct4) cuts state 64× and peak memory 2×, but not latency. A fused kernel was not built or measured, so these latencies are not deployed costs.
